market_summary: Mon 16 Nov close: S&P 500 -1.9%, Nasdaq -2.5% (in correction), SOX -5.3%. The 10-year Treasury sits at 5.12% (Nov 16), just off last week's highs, and a weak 10-year auction at 5.02% kept financing costs for data-centre builds elevated. AI stocks sold off on Nov 16 as a fresh US move to curb China's remote access to AI chips weighed, yet GPU rents held near records (H100 $3.08/hr, B200 $6.94/hr). DRAM spot is flat at highs, so memory has stopped accelerating but not rolled over. Nvidia's Q3 (Tue after US close = Wed morning AEDT) and Anthropic's IPO later this week are the next tests of AI capex appetite; power scarcity still supports energy and cooling names.
